name: Hierarchical Sampling
definition: Jointly trains two networks (coarse and fine). The coarse network predicts rough density from stratified samples. The fine network predicts precise colour using additional samples placed where coarse density was high, via importance sampling using the inverse-CDF of the coarse density distribution.
summary: Hierarchical sampling is a two-stage strategy that uses coarse density estimates to guide fine sample placement via importance sampling, concentrating effort on high-opacity regions to improve efficiency over uniform sampling.
